nodes.t: Separate bedrooms. Do you know what that headline costs? Honeymoon. Goa. Tomorrow. Holding hands every forty minutes.

nodes.n: Goa. A private villa, a private beach, and eleven photographers hiding in the coconut trees.

nodes.t: Hold my hand. Laugh like I said something funny.
Actually, say something funny. My face can't fake laughing anymore.

choice.t: Do your impression of your old coach.
Tell her about the time you got out to a ball that hit a pigeon.
Pick her up and run into the sea.

nodes.n: She laughs. A real one. Ugly and loud and nothing like the films. The photographers get nothing usable. It's perfect.
Sunset. The cameras have gone. She's sitting on the sand with her knees up, no makeup, sunburnt nose.

nodes.t: My father had a stroke four years ago. My mother runs everything now. My money, my films, my phone.
The flops weren't my fault. She picks the scripts. She picks the men. She picked Vivaan.

choice.t: Just sit with her. Say nothing.

nodes.n: She rests her head on your shoulder. It isn't for the cameras. There are no cameras.

msgs.t: I'm Tara's mother. I found a document in her safe.
Page nine has my name on it. Come to my house. Alone. Tomorrow, 11 AM.

nodes.cliff: Sushma Kapoor found the contract. And she wants to meet you alone.
